description: Data in support of "Declining cost of renewables and climate change curb the need for African hydropower expansion is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Angelo Carlino (Politecnico di Milano). Data and scripts to replicate the results and the figures presented in "Declining cost of renewables and climate change curb the need for African hydropower expansion". Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
